title: Conformational Changes in Ff Phage Protein gVp upon Complexation with Its Viral Single-Stranded DNA Revealed Using Magic-Angle Spinning Solid-State NMR.
authors: Kedem, Smadar; Hassid, Roni Rene; Shamir, Yoav; Goldbourt, Amir
one_liner_zh: 该文用固态NMR研究Ff噬菌体gVp蛋白与ssDNA复合物的构象变化，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但方法为实验NMR而非AI或物理模拟，且对象为非特异性ssDNA结合蛋白而非典型TF-DNA，故评分为5。
abstract: Gene V protein (gVp) of the bacteriophages of the Ff family is a non-specific single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) binding protein. gVp binds to viral DNA during phage replication inside host Escherichia coli cells, thereby blocking further replication and signaling the assembly of new phage particles. gVp is a dimer in solution and in crystal form. A structural model of the complex between gVp and ssDNA was obtained via docking the free gVp to structures of short ssDNA segments and via the detection of residues involved in DNA binding in solution. Using solid-state NMR, we characterized structural features of the gVp in complex with full-length viral ssDNA. We show that gVp binds ssDNA with an average distance of 5.5 A between the amino acid residues of the protein and the phosphate backbone of the DNA. Torsion angle predictions and chemical shift perturbations indicate that there were considerable structural changes throughout the protein upon complexation with ssDNA, with the most significant variations occurring at the ssDNA binding loop and the C-terminus. Our data suggests that the structure of gVp in complex with ssDNA differs significantly from the structure of gVp in the free form, presumably to allow for cooperative binding of dimers to form the filamentous phage particle.
abstract_zh: Ff家族噬菌体的基因V蛋白（gVp）是一种非特异性单链DNA（ssDNA）结合蛋白。在大肠杆菌宿主细胞内噬菌体复制期间，gVp与病毒DNA结合，从而阻断进一步复制并发出新噬菌体颗粒组装的信号。gVp在溶液和晶体形式中均为二聚体。通过将游离gVp与短ssDNA片段的结构进行对接，并检测溶液中参与DNA结合的残基，获得了gVp与ssDNA复合物的结构模型。利用固态核磁共振（solid-state NMR），我们表征了gVp与全长病毒ssDNA复合物的结构特征。我们显示，gVp与ssDNA结合时，蛋白质氨基酸残基与DNA磷酸骨架之间的平均距离为5.5 Å。扭转角预测和化学位移扰动表明，与ssDNA复合后，蛋白质整体发生显著结构变化，其中ssDNA结合环和C末端的变化最为显著。我们的数据表明，gVp与ssDNA复合物的结构显著不同于游离形式的gVp结构，这可能是为了允许二聚体协同结合以形成丝状噬菌体颗粒。
